name: falcon9_dragon upper_empty
note: Launch vehicle render model (tools/make_rocket_models.py), falcon9_dragon: upper_empty. Body frame: +Z toward the nose, origin at the aft end; engine bells below it. Capsule side-wall angle and nosecone shape from photographs. After its spacecraft has separated.

sources.subject: attitude
sources.value: +Z along the thrust axis (the sim passes it as 'velocity'), -Y (the ship's heat shield) down
sources.source: A rocket flies along its thrust axis; a gravity turn and an entry fly belly down.

sources.value: diameters and lengths rounded from the references; shapes (ogives, flaps, tapers) estimated from photographs
sources.source: SpaceX Dragon page: 8.1 m tall with trunk, 4 m across; trunk 3.7 m with body-mounted solar cells on half its circumference and four fins | Wikipedia 'Falcon 9 Block 5' / 'SpaceX Dragon 2'

sources.value: white: white paint (operator liveries in launch photographs); grey: grey paint (Soyuz, Long March detail); nozzle: dark regeneratively cooled nozzle metal; soot: a nozzle's sooty inside
sources.source: Liveries from photographs; reflectance from the presets.
